bio.summary: Schuchard is a sitting Boulder councilmember seeking another term. He focuses on living costs, wildfire and climate resilience, and the effectiveness of city government.

statements.text: Ramp up systems to protect Boulder from the rising danger of large-scale wildfire, strengthen flood mitigation, and prepare our energy, agricultural, and transportation systems to withstand extreme weather.
statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard

statements.text: Need: Boulder's downtown challenges reflect a nationwide pattern of chronic vacancies and low investment, aging buildings and infrastructure draining city resources, and high costs of living, on top of lacking healthcare and childcare that squeeze residents and business owners alike.
statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Ryan Schuchard

statements.text: Actual priorities, where real bandwidth goes right now: managing cash flow, preparing for Sundance, and staying responsive to the wide range of requests we hear from residents, individuals and organized advocates alike.
statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard

statements.text: My engagement: I hold open office hours downtown every Thursday morning at the Main Library cafe, no appointment needed.
statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Ryan Schuchard

statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard

statements.text: Expectations: Businesses can reasonably expect the City to do three things.
statements.speaker: Ryan Schuchard
statements.source_title: 2026 Mayoral and City Council Candidate Questions — Ryan Schuchard
